items.title: Trump’s deal with Putin will have little impact on US diesel prices, experts say

sentences.en: Trump’s deal with Putin will have little impact on US diesel prices, experts say.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，特朗普与普京的交易对美国柴油价格几乎没有影响。

sentences.en: Analysts say fuel will take weeks to ship and quantity is too small to affect prices, while full deal is unlikely to be met given damage to Russian refineries Trump announces partial ceasefire but Zelenskyy says deal is ‘news to me’ Donald Trump’s deal with Vladimir Putin to temporarily lift sanctions on US imports of Russian diesel will have little “meaningful” effect on motorists and businesses in the US and overseas, energy and foreign policy analysts have predicted.
sentences.zh: 分析师表示，燃料需要数周才能发货，数量太少无法影响价格，而鉴于特朗普宣布部分停火对俄罗斯炼油厂造成的损害，不太可能达成全面协议，但Zelenskyy表示，特朗普与弗拉基米尔·普京（ Vladimir Putin ）达成的暂时取消对美国进口俄罗斯柴油的制裁的协议对美国和海外的驾驶者和企业几乎没有“有意义的”影响，能源和外交政策分析师预测。

sentences.en: The US president infuriated Volodymyr Zelenskyy when he announced the deal on Friday, writing on Truth Social that the agreement with his Russia counterpart to supply millions of tonnes of diesel was essential to reduce fuel prices in the US, which have soared after his decision to go to war against Iran.
sentences.zh: 这位美国总统在周五宣布这笔交易时激怒了Volodymyr Zelenskyy ，他在Truth Social上写道，与俄罗斯总统达成的供应数百万吨柴油的协议对于降低美国的燃料价格至关重要，在他决定对伊朗开战后，美国的燃料价格飙升。

items.title: Twelve killed and hundreds injured in Houthi attack at Riyadh airport

sentences.en: Twelve killed and hundreds injured in Houthi attack at Riyadh airport.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装在利雅得机场发动袭击，造成12人死亡，数百人受伤。

sentences.en: Donald Trump evaluating whether US should join Saudi strikes against the Iran-backed Yemeni rebels The latest attack on the international airport in Saudi Arabia’s capital of Riyadh killed 12 people and injured more than 300 others, civil aviation authorities said early on Sunday, with some in a critical condition.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）评估美国是否应该加入沙特对伊朗支持的也门叛乱分子的罢工。民航当局周日早些时候表示，最近对沙特阿拉伯首都利雅得国际机场的袭击造成12人死亡， 300多人受伤，其中一些人情况危急。

sentences.en: A Saudi-led coalition blamed Iran-backed Houthi rebels in neighbouring Yemen.
sentences.zh: 沙特领导的一个联盟指责邻国也门的伊朗支持的胡塞叛乱分子。

sentences.en: A missile struck a King Khalid international airport complex housing terminals 3 and 4 for domestic flights, a regional official said, speaking on condition of anonymity because they weren’t authorised to speak to the media.
sentences.zh: 一名不愿透露姓名的地区官员说，一枚导弹击中了哈立德国王国际机场3号和4号航站楼，因为他们没有被授权与媒体交谈。

sentences.zh: 探险队希望在偏远的岛屿上找到飞行员阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特（ Amelia Earhart ）的飞机。

sentences.en: The team en route to the suspected crash site aim finally to solve the mystery of her 1937 disappearance.
sentences.zh: 前往疑似坠机现场的团队最终解决了她1937年失踪的谜团。
